facts.text: I am a senior in college.
I am assigned to work with a certain client for the semester as part of my final project.
The client’s company provides exclusive technical and managerial training within their field through instructional classes.
The company’s current training plan is not well structured.
The current method relies on the knowledge of section managers and course instructors to maintain requirements.
The company is losing resources within its yearly budget due to the incomplete and non-structured plan.
The company has non-allocation of employee hours to produce an efficient work environment.
The company is seeking help determining a model to equate the number of instructors to the number of hours of instruction that can be provided.
There are 8 technical training sections in the organization based on particular disciplines of technical training.
Each technical training section has independent variables that factor into determining the ratio of instructors to hours of instruction.
Due to budget constraints and employee attrition, the company is looking for a new model to distribute instructors.
The new model should convey to stakeholders and other agencies an accurate estimate of required resources.
The new model should help stakeholders and other agencies understand the effects of increasing or decreasing the company’s staffing levels or budget.
The client wants analysis of each section to determine the variables they face in deciding their output.
The client wants a relative quantitative measure of these variables.
The client wants a partial or complete automated tool and/or model using MS Excel that can consider shifting variables and provide a relative number of hours.
I asked whether, assuming I input responses to the above questions, you would be able to create such a model in Excel.

events.text: Semester final project assignment with a client
